annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 supplementing Regulation (EC) No 715/2007 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 5 and Euro 6) and on access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 supplementing Regulation (EC) No 715/2007 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 5 and Euro 6) and on access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 175
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Regulation 2017/1151 introduces the WLTP test procedure into EU type-approval of light passenger and commercial vehicles for emissions (Euro 5/6). It sets type-approval, conformity of production, in-service conformity, OBD, real-driving-emissions and access to repair information requirements. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces NEDC with the WLTP test procedure for light-duty vehicle emissions and CO2 type-approval
Requires OBD systems and manufacturer access to vehicle OBD and repair information for independent operators
Sets conformity of production and in-service conformity checks with statistical methods and audits
Mandates tamper protection for odometer and emission control electronics
Phased application from September 2017 to 2019; repeals Regulation (EC) No 692/2008 from 2022
